Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public.

SPECIFICATION FOR 

'CONTACT' TYPE COUPLING FOR VACUUM 

AND PRESSURE SYSTEMS CONNECTION 

BETWEEN TRACTOR AND TRAILER 



1. Scope — Specifies the form and dimensions of 'contact' type coupling for vacuum and pressure 
systems connection between tractor and trailer. 

Note — Coupling for brake system shall be according to 15:9905-1981 'Specification for pneumatic coupling 
between tractor and trailer'. 

2. Dimensions 

2.1 The dimensions and general arrangements of 'contact' type coupling shall be as shown in Fig. 1, 2 
and 3.

EXPLANATORY NOTE 

In the preparation of this standard, assistance has been derived from BS AU 5 : 1963 tSpecification 
for dimensions of a 'contact' type coupling for vacuum and pressure braking systems on trailers and 
semi-trailers', issued by the British Standards Institution ( BSI ).
